content_text:
Survey Draftsperson – Gosford
de Witt Consulting is looking for a Survey Draftsperson to join our growing Gosford team.
This is an opportunity to work across a diverse range of surveying projects, collaborate closely with experienced surveyors and deliver drafting services within an established multidisciplinary consultancy.
As our Gosford office grows, there is scope for the role to develop into leading and coordinating additional drafting team members.
About the role
You will coordinate and deliver the Gosford office’s survey drafting requirements, working closely with our surveyors to prepare accurate, high-quality drawings.
Your work will include:
- Preparing set-out plans, deposited plans, detail plans and identification plans
- Supporting projects across construction, engineering, cadastral surveying, digital terrain modelling (DTM), laser scanning and drone surveys
- Liaising with surveyors to clarify project requirements and incorporate survey information
- Managing drafting priorities to meet project deadlines
- Checking drawings for accuracy, consistency and completeness
About you
We’re looking for someone who takes pride in their work, communicates well and enjoys contributing to a collaborative team.
You will bring:
- Experience using AutoCAD Civil 3D
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to producing accurate drawings
- Good organisation skills and the ability to manage competing priorities
- The ability to work independently and collaborate closely with our surveying team
- A proactive attitude and willingness to continue developing your skills
Knowledge of the surveying industry and experience preparing survey plans would be highly regarded.
About us
de Witt Consulting is a well-established and respected multidisciplinary consultancy providing Surveying, Town Planning, Ecology and Project Management services across NSW.
With offices in Newcastle, the Central Coast and the Mid-Western region, our team works across residential development, construction, infrastructure, renewables, mining and major civil projects.
We invest in our people and provide genuine opportunities to develop technically and progress their careers.
What we offer
- Exposure to a diverse range of surveying projects
- A supportive and experienced team
- Opportunities to develop your technical skills
- Scope to progress into a drafting team leadership role as the office grows
- An attractive employment package
- Flexible working arrangements for suitable applicants to support work–life balance
If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute your drafting skills and grow your career on the Central Coast, we’d like to hear from you.
To join the de Witt Consulting team, submit your application via SEEK.
